subject: Thank you for rolling with the schedule change
text:
Hi,

Just wanted to say thanks. I know I moved things around last minute. The change in priorities was not something I planned. I really appreciate how you picked up the extra shift without complaining. It took pressure off everyone. I also liked your suggestion about the snack setup. That made things smoother for us.

I know it is not always easy when plans flip so fast. You handled it kindly, and that mattered a lot. It is lucky to have you on this side of the table. It made the evening feel manageable. I did not expect you to adapt so readily. That was generous. You have a way of making a scramble sound like a small detour. I hope the rest of your week is calm and kind. Maybe we can catch up soon. Next time, I will buy the coffee.

Cheers,
